title: Has Scientific Talent Shifted from Depth to Breadth?Evidence across Papers, Knowledge Inputs, Careers, and Teams
abstract: arXiv:2609.14425v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence raises a central question for scientific training and organization. Is research shifting from deep specialization toward broad individual knowledge? We examine this proposition across papers, cited knowledge, contributor histories, and teams using 47,959 articles from six fields over 2010-2025, 51,736 resolved cited works, and chronologically reconstructed prior publication histories for 1,754 randomly selected index contributors. From 2010 to 2022, team size increased by an estimated 37.3% (95% confidence interval [34.4%, 40.3%]), while paper topic breadth declined by 0.0144 on a 0-1 hierarchical distance scale. Cited knowledge was stable to modestly broader, revealing a divergence between focused outputs and the reach of knowledge inputs. Established contributors' prior breadth increased by 0.0190 [-0.0078, 0.0459] by 2019-2022, within a +/-0.05 equivalence bound assessed in sensitivity analysis. In

translated_title: 科学人才是否从深度转向了广度？基于论文、知识输入、职业生涯与团队的证据
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能为科学训练与科研组织提出了一个核心问题：研究是否正在从深度专业化转向个体的广博知识？我们通过47,959篇2010-2025年间六个领域的论文、51,736条已解析的引文文献，以及1,754名随机选取的索引贡献者的时序重建发表历史，在论文、引用知识、贡献者履历和团队四个层面对这一命题进行了检验。从2010年到2022年，团队规模估计增长了37.3%（95%置信区间[34.4%, 40.3%]），而论文主题广度在0-1的层级距离尺度上下降了0.0144。引用的知识保持稳定至略微拓宽，揭示了聚焦的产出与知识输入广度之间的分化。资深贡献者的先前广度到2019-2022年增加了0.0190 [-0.0078, 0.0459]，处于敏感性分析中评估的±0.05等效性界限之内。
tldr: 基于2010-2025年六领域近4.8万篇论文的大规模实证分析发现，尽管团队规模增长37.3%、引用知识与资深研究者的知识广度略微拓宽，论文主题广度反而收窄，表明科研产出正趋于更加聚焦，而非从深度专业化转向个体广博化。
en_tdlr: Large-scale analysis of nearly 48,000 papers across six fields (2010-2025) shows that despite a 37.3% growth in team size and modestly broader cited knowledge and career histories, paper topic breadth has narrowed, indicating scientific output is becoming more focused rather than shifting from depth to breadth.
